behaviour.pause: disabled while busy, while held, OR while the hold state is unknown
behaviour.resume: disabled only when the page KNOWS there is nothing to clear (holdKnown && hold === null), so it stays live in the unknown state
behaviour.act: the same two guards are repeated inside act(kind), so a programmatic call cannot slip past the disabled attribute (pause refuses when !holdKnown; resume refuses only when the hold is KNOWN to be absent)
